messages:
Anya: quick question — reranker bench shows MRR drop ~2.7% when switching eval formatting from 'doc_concatenate' to 'doc_preserve_paragraphs'. anyone seen this?
Sam: what dataset and pooling config? pooled or holdout?
Anya: webqa-dev (pooled), 50k queries. compare: truncate to 512 after concat vs preserve paragraph boundaries and truncate each para to keep structure.
Liam: formatting often changes tokenization and where relevant spans land. can you paste the eval args?
Anya: sure —
```
--dataset webqa-dev
--format doc_preserve_paragraphs
--truncate 512
--metric ndcg@10,mrr@10
--seed 42
```
Sam: have you tried per-query doc caps? doc_preserve can make contexts longer and promote noisy docs early.
Maria: also double-check label pooling depth. pooled sets with long docs bias ndcg normalization. try a full-holdout run vs pooled sample.
Anya: good call. I'll kick off holdout. @Sam fyi. @eval-bot can you spin quick int8-ptq vs fp16 runs for both formats?
eval-bot: queued job 2034567901 — running rerank-eval: baseline-fp16 vs int8-ptq on webqa-dev (pooled) across both formats.
eval-bot: DONE 2034567907 — summary results: 
- baseline fp16 doc_concatenate: NDCG@10 0.732, MRR@10 0.618
- fp16 doc_preserve_paragraphs: NDCG@10 0.719, MRR@10 0.602
- int8-ptq doc_concatenate: NDCG@10 0.730, MRR@10 0.616
- int8-ptq doc_preserve_paragraphs: NDCG@10 0.729, MRR@10 0.615
Liam: interesting — quantization practically closes the formatting gap. suggests formatting interacts with attention patterns and PTQ smooths differences.
Sam: could still be seed/noise. what's CI on the MRR delta?
Anya: bootstrapped 95% CI for MRR diff ~ ±0.9%, gap persists beyond noise but smaller than originally thought.
Maria: follow-up plan: (1) rerun with per-query doc cap=3, (2) rerun doc_preserve but join paras with explicit <sep> token to force serialization, (3) extract tokenizer boundary distribution to see where truncation cuts relevant spans.
Sam: also verify metric tie-breaking: our MRR picks first relevant doc index; if doc_preserve reorders shorter relevant snippets earlier, that can shift MRR even if overall relevance mass is same.
Anya: i'll run those overnight and post artifacts. if results hold, we should annotate model-onboard PR with a short note: "eval formatting sensitivity: doc-paragraph-preserve lowers MRR vs concat in fp16 for webqa-dev; int8-ptq reduces effect."
Liam: +1 to noting it. could save future debugging time.
Anya: thanks all :rocket:
